thread:
alex: Heads-up — heatmap shows a bunch of rows with empty org for traffic that went through the exchange proxy. Noticed after the 4/12 deploy.

alex: Quick repro: client -> auth-exchange -> mint project token -> backend. The console shows project usage, but org column is blank.

maya: can you paste an example trace or header dump?

alex: pasted from staging logs (redacted):
```
POST /v1/exchange
Host: auth.internal
Authorization: Bearer sa-token
Response: 200
Set-Authorization: Bearer <project-token>
X-Org-Header: ""
```
alex: X-Org-Header is present but empty. token payload does include org claim when we decode.

jon: FYI PR 4107 refactored the signer + header mapping. I remember we removed a thin wrapper that copied claims into headers — could be the regression.

liz-observability: current ingestion order: (1) explicit header, (2) token.claims.org, (3) fallback 'org:unknown'. If header present but empty we currently index as blank which explains the heatmap rows.

maya: short-term fix idea: ingestion should treat empty header as missing and fall back to token claim. That avoids any header emission changes. Long-term we should decide whether the exchange service is allowed to echo org headers at all.

product: important privacy/legal note: some customers on Dedicated asked for org stripping on exchange to avoid cross-tenant leakage. Any change to header emission needs console-pref and opt-in.

alex: UX problem: support sees blank orgs and can't tell if the traffic is un-attributed vs intentionally stripped. We need a way to surface exchange-origin.

maya: implementation plan I'm proposing:
- ingestion: if header missing or empty -> use token.org claim if present
- add ingestion metric: `auth.exchange.header_empty` with labels: had_token_org=(true|false)
- add console flag: "Emit exchange org header" (off by default for Dedicated)
- add a new column on auth heatmap: `attribution_source` values: direct, exchange, exchange(stripped)

jon: sgtm. I'll take the code change for ingestion + unit tests. maya can do the metric + console flag PR.

liz-observability: I'll add an alerts rule: if rate of `auth.exchange.header_empty` > 1% of exchange traffic for a customer, page paging team and add a saved query to surface the affected projects. Also a dashboard row for "exchange attribution gaps".

sam-support: if we add the `attribution_source` column, can we make the default table view hide exchange-stripped rows (so support doesn't spam customers)? We should have a quick-filter.

product: agreed — support-filter default: hide exchange(stripped) but allow showing with a tooltip explaining privacy reasons. Also add a rollout note in the console changelog.

alex: deploy checklists:
- [ ] unit + integration tests for ingestion fallback
- [ ] metric emitted and dashboard panels created
- [ ] console flag behind feature gate for Dedicated
- [ ] support docs + changelog entry
- [ ] Do not enable header emission globally until support tooling is live

deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: auth-ingestion-fallback v2 -> staging :rocket:

maya: pairing with jon 10:30am PT tomorrow to run integr tests against staging. I'll drop a short RFC in eng-platform for the console flag scope.

alex: thanks all — small fix but medium UX impact, nice catch. :thumbsup:
